items.name: satin-styles
items.title: Satin styles
items.description: Satin tokens, motion and every class the components use, precompiled. Import it once (for example in main.tsx); `.dark` or `data-theme="dark"` on a parent for dark mode, `data-theme="system"` to follow the OS. No Tailwind needed.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The `cn` helper: joins class names and lets the later class win.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Folds sections of content under their titles, one or many open at a time.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: Runs an action and shows how it went in place: a spinner, then a checkmark.

items.name: agent-loading
items.title: Loading
items.description: What shows while an agent works: a live mark, a shimmering label and the time so far.

items.name: agent-picker
items.title: Agent picker
items.description: Switches which agent answers: avatar, name and one line on what it does.

items.name: agent-suggestion
items.title: Agent suggestion
items.description: Something the agent prepared, an email, a meeting or a CRM update, for the user to approve.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stays on the page until it is dealt with: info, success, warning or error.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: One line of news across the top or bottom of the page, with a link and a close.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attached to a prompt or a message, with its type, size and a preview.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Shows a person or workspace with initials on a tone colour.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a status or a category.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Promotes a next step, a guide or a new feature with a line of copy and one action, on a mesh or plain background.

items.name: banner-mesh
items.title: Banner mesh
items.description: The Satin Banner mesh component.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: One metric over a period as bars, with a tooltip on the hovered one.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the page sits and leads back up the path.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Starts an action. One primary per screen; secondary and tertiary for the rest.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons that belong together, joined into one block or spaced as a toolbar.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content and actions under a title, with an optional footer.

items.name: channel-chart
items.title: Channel chart
items.description: How a total splits across channels: a stacked bar and a legend row per channel.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The Satin Chart component.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns an option on or off as part of a form.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact, removable tag for filters, suggestions and people.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Numbered sources in an answer, with a preview on hover and the list under it.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Shows code or a diff with a filename, line numbers and a copy button.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Picks one or more values from a long list by typing to filter it, then Apply.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: The ⌘K palette: search every action and page, then run one with Enter.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The actions for one thing, at the pointer, on right-click or a long press.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: Asks once what the site may store: Customize, Reject all or Accept all.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Picks a day or a range from a calendar, with a quick year.

items.name: decision-card
items.title: Decision card
items.description: One question from the agent, with answers to pick, rank or rewrite, and Skip or Continue.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Asks for a decision or a short input before the user moves on.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: How a total splits into a few parts, as a ring with the sum in the middle.

items.name: dot
items.title: Dot
items.description: A small status dot that marks state or category next to a label.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Opens a short list of actions or values from a button.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Fills a space with no content yet: says why it is empty and offers the first step.

items.name: field-group
items.title: Field group
items.description: Fields or options that answer one question, under one legend, with one error.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: Takes files by drop or browse, shows each upload and what failed, then the attached files.

items.name: floating
items.title: Floating
items.description: The Satin Floating component.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Lays out fields, groups and sections, hands them errors by name and focuses the first one.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form field
items.description: Wraps a control with a label, a description and an error message.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview of a person, place or file while the pointer rests on its link.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line of text, with a label, a hint and icons.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: A field joined with an addon, a select or a button in one block.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in separate cells, with paste and SMS autofill.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key, alone or as the keys of one shortcut.

items.name: labels
items.title: Labels
items.description: The Satin Labels component.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One metric over a period as a smooth line, with the value of the hovered point.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Text that goes somewhere, calm in a paragraph, marked when it leaves the site.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Rows of people, files or settings, each with a title, meta and actions.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One chat turn: a bubble for the user, plain text with actions for the assistant.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message actions
items.description: Status, feedback, copy and share under an assistant reply.

items.name: notification
items.title: Notification
items.description: A card for something the app did or heard about, with a picture, a badge and a close on its corner.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: A number with − and + and the arrow keys, kept between a min and a max.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through a long list one page at a time.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field with a show and hide button.

items.name: pointer-modality
items.title: Pointer modality
items.description: The Satin Pointer modality component.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small titled panel that opens next to the button that asked for it.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task has got, or that it is still running.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt bar
items.description: Where people write to an agent: attachments, model, voice and send.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Lets people pick exactly one option from a short list.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search bar
items.description: A search field for the sidebar or a toolbar, with ⌘K to focus it from anywhere.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Switches between two to five views or filters in place.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Picks one value from a list, with a label, a hint and an error like any field.

items.name: selectable-card
items.title: Selectable card
items.description: The Satin Selectable card component.

items.name: selectable-checkbox
items.title: Selectable checkbox
items.description: Pick any number of options, each a card with a line of explanation and an icon.

items.name: selectable-radio
items.title: Selectable radio
items.description: Pick one option from a few, each a card with a line of explanation and an icon.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule between blocks, across or down, with an optional word in the middle.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from the edge for a task that needs more room than a dialog.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation: pages with icons and counters, collapsible groups and an icon-only rail.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Holds the place of content that is still loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a number or a range by dragging, with the value to read or type.

items.name: sliding-indicator
items.title: Sliding indicator
items.description: The Satin Sliding indicator component.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Says something is loading when there is no telling how long it takes.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: The usual action, with an arrow that opens its variations.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming text
items.description: An answer writing itself out as it arrives, at an even pace with a caret.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, with immediate effect.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of records with sortable columns, selection and sideways scroll.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between two to six views of the same page or panel.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input for notes, requests and longer answers.

items.name: thinking
items.title: Thinking
items.description: What an agent did, folded into a summary that opens onto its steps.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short, passing message about something that just happened.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed to switch an option on or off.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only control and shows the shortcut that runs it.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: The line chart with its area filled down to the baseline in a fading gradient.

items.name: satin-pro-styles
items.title: Satin Pro styles
items.description: Satin Pro's own classes and component CSS, precompiled: only what Satin styles doesn't already have. Import it after satin.css.

items.name: bulk-action-bar
items.title: Bulk action bar
items.description: Appears when rows are selected: the count, the actions with their shortcuts, and one toast to undo the batch.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: The table people work in: sort, resize, pin and hide columns, edit cells in place, and save views.

items.name: toast-batch
items.title: Toast batch
items.description: The Satin Pro Toast batch component.
